cs.t: > awkward notches 1 notch.  Singular.  Not plural. Also, the Pixel 3 does not have a notch.  That's only the Pixel 3 XL. > small storage wat?  My Pixel 3 has 128 gig.  That's quite a bit.  An SD card slot would be nice to expand it, but I'm still pretty happy with 128.  Stores my entire MP3 collection with tens of gigabytes left over for taking pics and recording videos. > RAM I'll give you this one.  Having only 4 gig feels a bit dated, but I'm not sure if it's really an issue. > Mediocre at best battery 3,000 mAh is pretty standard.  And the Pixel 3 sips the battery pretty lightly.  My previous phone was a Motorola Droid Turbo.  Even with its 3900 mAh battery, after using GPS + Bluetooth for 90 or so minutes for my commute to/from work, plus about an hour of browsing reddit during breaks at work, I'd come home with 40% left on the battery.  With my Pixel 3, with the same usage patterns, I finish the day with about 60% of my battery left.
